compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a list of upcoming events. Each event entry includes the date, city, state, and venue. The events are listed in chronological order, starting from March and ending in December. The screen also features a navigation menu icon at the top left corner and a status bar at the top. At the bottom of the list, there is an option labeled "THIS MONTH" and a link to "tap for more" events.
